He guided the new President at the national cemetery on the morning of 1993-02-25 (매일경제 1993-02-25) and brought papers for the President to sign that afternoon (조선일보 1993-02-26). The first 김영삼 cabinet was named on the morning of 1993-02-26 and received its 임명장 that afternoon (동아일보 1993-02-26). The outgoing ministers left on 1993-02-26 and held their 이임식 that morning (서울신문 1993-02-27 on 백광현, 동아일보 1993-02-26 on 이용만, 한겨레 1993-02-26 on the economic ministers, 국민일보 1993-02-27 on 이임식 across ministries). A 총무처 official had said on 1993-02-24 that the outgoing ministers need not resign and would hand over when successors were appointed (매일경제 1993-02-24). No report dating 이문석's own exit was found, so the end is the successor's 임명장 day, 1993-02-26. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 alone reports that the outgoing cabinet's resignations were submitted and accepted on 1993-02-25 (see issues). issues.desc: Lineage mapping. The 1998 holdover 심우영 (총무처, 1997-08-06..1998-02-27) sits in interior.verified.json and is copied here with from_main true. offices_1988.json maps 총무처 to general_affairs (ministry_to_lineage_overrides), and build_panel.py applies that override and skips from_main spells from ext88 files, so the spell is counted once, under general_affairs. No tier 1-3 evidence against the main record was found. 매일신문 1997-08-06 (09:30 임명장) and 한겨레 1997-08-07 agree with its start of 1997-08-06.

MOIS 역대장관 page (총무처 tab, tier 2) disagrees with dated news on four dates. (1) 김용갑 end 1989-03-06, but he held press conferences as minister on 1989-03-13, resigned on 1989-03-14 and the resignation was accepted on 1989-03-16 (동아일보, 한겨레, 서울신문, 세계일보, 한국경제 1989-03-17). (2) 김한규 start 1997-03-06, but he was appointed on 1996-12-20 (경향신문, 세계일보, 문화일보, 매일신문 1996-12-21) and appears as minister in January and February 1997. (3) 장기오 end 1988-02-24, but the 김정렬 cabinet's resignations were accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 and he received the Presidents at the inauguration that morning. (4) 서석재 end 1995-08-03, the day he submitted his resignation, which was accepted on 1995-08-04. This file follows the news in all four cases.

ko.wikipedia '대한민국 총무처' (oldid 41882248) gives 김용갑 1988-02-25..1989-03-08 and a 권한대행 손종석 (차관) for 1989-03-09..1989-03-15. Neither is supported by the news. 김용갑 was active as minister on 1989-03-13 and left the office only after submitting his resignation on the afternoon of 1989-03-14. Between 1989-03-14 and the acceptance on 1989-03-16 he was absent but still minister, so no vacancy and no acting record are entered. 손종석 was then 차관 and was reported as a possible successor (경향신문, 동아일보, 매일경제 1989-03-16).

이문석 end 1993-02-26 (inferred_from_successor). A first build of this file used 1993-02-25 (medium) on the strength of 중앙일보 1993-02-25, which reports that the outgoing 현승종 cabinet submitted resignations on 1993-02-25 and all were accepted. The MOIS page and ko.wikipedia also print 1993-02-25. A second search (scripts general_affairs_ext88_09 and _10) found several day-after reports that the outgoing ministers left on 1993-02-26, the day the new cabinet was named and appointed. 서울신문 1993-02-27 calls 백광현 '이날 퇴임한', 동아일보 1993-02-26 p.3 reports 이임식 of 최각규, 이용만, 강현욱 and 한봉수 that morning, 한겨레 1993-02-26 writes '26일 일제히 퇴임하는 경제부처 장관들', and 국민일보 1993-02-27 describes 이임식 at several ministries at about the same hour. 매일경제 1993-02-24 had quoted a 총무처 official saying no resignation was needed. No report dates 이문석's own exit, so the successor's 임명장 day is used. When this file was rebuilt (2026-09-26), the agriculture, culture, defense, energy, environment, epb, finance, interior, justice, public_info, science, sports and unification ext88 files also ended their outgoing ministers on 1993-02-26. The education (조완규) and foreign (이상옥) ext88 files used 1993-02-25 from the same 중앙일보 report, so the 1993 transition was not yet uniform across lineages.

Date convention. start is the 임명장 day. It was one or two days after the announcement in 1987-07 (13/14), 1989-03 (16/17), 1990-03 (17/19), 1991-12 (19/20), 1992-06 (25/26), 1993-12 (21/22), 1994-12 (23/24), 1996-01 (30/31) and 1997-08 (5/6), and the same day in 1988-02-25, 1993-02-26, 1995-08-07 and 1996-12-20. The MOIS start dates match the 임명장 day in every case except 김한규. When a predecessor had no separately dated resignation acceptance, end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor), following justice.verified.json and interior.verified.json. The MOIS page prints the day before in those cases. Dated acceptances were used for 장기오 (1988-02-25), 김용갑 (1989-03-16), 서석재 (1995-08-04) and 김기재 (1996-01-30).

Vacancy 1995-08-05..1995-08-06 between 서석재 (resignation accepted 1995-08-04) and 김기재 (appointed 1995-08-07). 세계일보 1995-08-06 describes the post as vacant. No source naming an acting head was found (News Library and BigKinds searched for 총무처 차관 and 직무대행 in 1995-08-01..08-09). 원진식, the sitting 차관 (appointed 1994-11-03, still 차관 in 1995-12), is entered as an inferred acting head, as justice.verified.json does for 김각영.
No 총무처장관 in the window held a deputy PM title. The only deputy PM posts in the window were attached to 경제기획원 and 통일원 (offices_1988.json deputy_pm_designations).

Person fields. Birth dates come from the NA member record where the person sat in the Assembly (김용갑, 이상배, 최창윤, 서석재, 김기재, 김한규) and from ko.wikipedia otherwise (장기오, 김용래, 이연택, 황영하, 조해녕).
